meta.name: remarkable
meta.description: Access reMarkable tablet documents, notebooks, PDFs, and EPUBs. Use when the user wants to read, search, browse, or extract text from their reMarkable tablet. Supports handwriting OCR, typed text, annotations, highlights, and page rendering to PNG/SVG. Triggers: "reMarkable", "tablet notes", "handwritten notes", "remarkable read", "remarkable search", "remarkable browse".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 读取和搜索 reMarkable 平板上的笔记与文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你使用 reMarkable 平板并需要从电脑访问笔记和文档。
copy.tagline_en: Read and search notes and documents on your reMarkable tablet
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use a reMarkable tablet and need to access your notes and documents from your computer.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以读取、搜索、浏览你 reMarkable 平板上的文档、笔记本、PDF 和 EPUB，还能识别手写文字（需配置 Google Vision API），并将页面渲染为 PNG 或 SVG 图片。
howto.when: 当你提到“reMarkable”、“平板笔记”、“手写笔记”等关键词，或要求读取、搜索、浏览 reMarkable 内容时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜索 reMarkable 里包含“会议”的笔记。
say.note: Claude 会调用搜索工具查找匹配内容。

say.text: 读取我最近修改的 reMarkable 文档。
say.note: Claude 会列出最近文档并读取内容。

say.text: 把 reMarkable 上第一页笔记渲染成图片。
say.note: Claude 会调用图片渲染工具生成 PNG。

howto.what_en: Claude can read, search, browse documents, notebooks, PDFs, and EPUBs on your reMarkable tablet, perform handwriting OCR (with Google Vision API), and render pages as PNG or SVG.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "reMarkable", "tablet notes", "handwritten notes", or ask to read, search, or browse reMarkable content.

say_en.text: Search my reMarkable for notes containing "meeting".
say_en.note: Claude will use the search tool to find matches.

say_en.text: Read my most recent reMarkable document.
say_en.note: Claude will list recent documents and read content.

say_en.text: Render the first page of my reMarkable notebook as an image.
say_en.note: Claude will call the image rendering tool to generate PNG.
